user.title: Radio Favorites
user.description: Create one central radio list for your Home Assistant media players.

init.title: Radio station management
init.description: Add or delete as many stations as needed. Changes are saved only when you choose Finish and close.

menu_options.add_station: Add or update a radio station

add_station.title: Add or update station
add_station.description: Enter a display name and the direct HTTP or HTTPS audio stream URL. Reusing a name updates its URL.

delete_station.title: Delete station
delete_station.description: Select the station to remove from the central list.
